He is best known for his work in logic and metaphysics, particularly his commentary on Avicenna's 'Isagoge'. Khashayar was a member of the famous 'Khwarazmian School', based in Bukhara, and was a contemporary of Nasir al-Din al-Tusi. He is considered to have played a significant role in the preservation and transmission of Avicenna's works during this tumultuous period.

Khashayar is remembered for his efforts to maintain law and order, as well as his patronage of scholars and learning institutions in the city.
